SamenvattingAs a warehouse employee in Ridderkerk, you ensure that all fresh products are ready on time and in perfect condition to end up in everyone's refrigerator. Thanks to your efforts, production continues to run smoothly and efficiently. Good work! Over de functieWhether you are packing salads or ensuring everything runs smoothly behind the scenes, you and your team are responsible for quality and freshness. No two days are the same: the variety keeps you active and your working day flies by. A hands-on job full of energy. 
Your duties will include:
- Lifting and stacking boxes on pallets
- Handling materials and tools such as knives and cutters safely
- Carefully packing ready-made salads according to guidelines

The warehouse is open 6 days a week, so flexibility is important. There are 3 shifts:
Morning: 06:00/08:00 to 15:00/17:00
Afternoon: 14:00 to 23:00
Night: 21:00 to 05:00

This family business combines pride in its Dutch roots with innovation and sustainability. Every day, more than 350 employees deliver fresh products to the Dutch food service industry from their modern location in Ridderkerk. Would you like to join their team that thinks big and delivers fresh?

- You have experience in production
- You are willing to work shifts

Become a Production Team Leader in Beuningen and lead a production line in a modern food production environment. Earn a gross monthly salary between €3,490 and €3,885, including shift allowance, work in a two-shift system and receive a direct contract with the company.

Are you driven by strategic planning, data-led decision-making, and the opportunity to help shape the future of the fashion industry? While this is not an active vacancy, we are building a talent pool of experienced Buying & Demand Planners for upcoming opportunities.
If you thrive on optimizing seasonal plans, collaborating with global teams, and delivering intelligent purchasing strategies, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact. Join our talent community and be among the first to hear about exciting roles that influence the global fashion market.

As a Buying & Demand Planning Specialist, you will:

- Collaborate closely with vendors and internal teams to manage seasonal planning activities.

- Execute strategic buying decisions across multiple seasons.

- Maintain seamless communication with merchandisers, product developers, and suppliers.

- Oversee material bookings and manage a comprehensive global order book for your assigned categories.

Who You Are

- You have a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, or a related field.

- You have excellent communication skills in English (written en verbal).

- You bring at least 2 years of experience in buying within a fashion retail or large Ecommerce organization.

- You excel in data analysis, with strong Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, IF statements).

- You are an effective communicator and negotiator, able to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

- You thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments and have a keen eye for detail.

Why Join Our Talent Pool?

- Priority access to exciting career opportunities in Buying & Demand Planning.

- Work with some of the most iconic fashion brands in the industry.

- Be part of a team that values creativity, sustainability, and innovation.

- Collaborate in a fast-growing, international environment based in Amsterdam.

Collect orders using an electric pallet truck (EPT), forklift, or reach truck;

Pack orders and prepare them for shipment; 
Process orders administratively in the system; 
Collaborate with your colleagues to keep the process running smoothly.
